core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt signaling
name: Wnt secretion, non-canonical signaling and Frizzled receptor turnover
rationale: All members concern Wnt ligand production (PORCN, biogenesis, secretion) and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling at the receptor level; unlike the smaller secretion/calcium theme it adds Frizzled ubiquitination, LRP5 mutant signaling and developmental outputs (paraxial mesoderm, ciliary localization), and unlike the canonical confusables it lacks destruction-complex and TCF/beta-catenin members.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt signaling
name: Porcupine-dependent Wnt secretion and Wnt5a/calcium signaling
rationale: Members split into PORCN-dependent Wnt ligand biogenesis and secretion (incl. LGK974 inhibition) and the Wnt5a-driven Ca2+ non-canonical branch; it lacks the Frizzled ubiquitination and LRP5 members of its superset, the destruction-complex/TCF members of canonical confusables, and the planar-polarity/convergent-extension members of the PCP confusable.
